says: The runner makes `check_threw` with Schema `make` from the program's own error class name, which can be empty, while the made field is `Text`.
proof: In: next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/Program.ts:649-657 `errorClass` is the program's `error` (only `Schema.String` over the Worker, next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/Execution.ts:44) or `constructor.name`, which is `""` for an anonymous Error subclass. Make: next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/Runner.ts:1404 `SupervisorMsg.cases.check_threw.make({ ... error, ... })`, whose `error` is `Text`, a `NonEmptyString` (next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/internal/supervisor.ts:177).
cost: A program that throws an anonymous Error subclass (`constructor.name` is empty) crashes the runner with a defect instead of a typed failure. The `Failure.cases.*.make` on the line before predates #1619 and throws on the same value first, so #1619 did not cause it; the call still breaks decision 0215.
